Pullback entry $141-$144, stop $135 floor, TP1 $154 break above 50-DMA, TP2 $165 prior consolidation.

Pullback to $105-$109 from $134 cycle high — classic mean-revert in a multi-quarter uptrend. Forward P/E 9.5 — cheap on $90 oz operating costs. Stop $99 protects against 200-DMA break.

AstraZeneca at $187.46, -2.14% below 50-DMA, +1.53% Monday. EU pharma defensive: oncology pipeline (Tagrisso, Imfinzi) + diabetes/cardiovascular Farxiga. 200-DMA $179.64 secular support. Tight stop $180 protects against 200-DMA break, R:R 2.14 to TP1 $202 (50-DMA reclaim). EU diversification + healthcare defensive double-tilt.

GLD at $417.40 pulled back -3.39% from 50-DMA $432.06 but 200-DMA $398.54 still below = uptrend intact. +1.43% Monday on weak tape. Gold = pure risk-off ballast in EARLY RISK-OFF regime (P(crisis) 0.15, P(early_risk_off) 0.50). Real rates compressing as 10Y stabilizes. Duke Energy at $123.81 retracing to 200-DMA support ($124.08). Nestlé ADR at $99.71, hugging 50-DMA $99.43 with tight consolidation past 30d. Swiss consumer staples mega-cap, defensive bid in risk-off. 3.97% yield, forward P/E 16.4. Weak USD tailwind for CHF-denominated revenue. Entry $98-$101, stop $94 below base, TP1 $108 52w high zone, TP2 $115 fresh ATH territory.

TLT at $83.91, +1.07% Monday — long-duration Treasury bid in EARLY RISK-OFF regime. 50-DMA $86.22 and 200-DMA $88.10 both above = mean-revert bounce setup at multi-month base. 30Y yield around 5.15% near cycle high → duration trade tactical buy. **Uncorrelated with equity longs** — pure portfolio hedge replacing XLP (XLP overlapped PG at ~85% rho). stressScenarios.description: Fed rate hike +100bps: equities fall via ERP compression, bonds reprice
Equity market crash -20%: beta-adjusted drawdown across all positions
VIX spike to 40: volatility repricing, equity decline proportional to vol exposure
Crypto crash: BTC -30%, altcoins down more, minimal equity impact
Geopolitical crisis: risk-off flight to safety, equity decline, gold/USD rally
